svg.text: Nios V <-> Caliptra 2.x signal map (nios_caliptra2x_top, Agilex 5E A5E 065)
▶ awaddr[18:0] awburst awsize awlen awid awlock
▶ araddr[18:0] arburst arsize arlen arid arlock
Status outputs (to status PIO, bit position shown)
Tied off at the top level
Inside the wrapper, not on the boundary:
mailbox SRAM 256 KiB + ECC, ROM 96 KiB (caliptra-rom.hex), VeeR ICCM/DCCM, Adams-Bridge memories;
AXI manager (DMA) tied never-ready (passive mode); all ss_* subsystem straps = 0;
ctrl[1:0] (reset value 0 = Caliptra held in reset)
rst_release (ninit_done) + board reset_n give sys_reset_n, which drives the Nios reset and the glue 2-FF reset sync.
▶ input to Caliptra ◀ output from Caliptra ⇆ handshake (valid / ready) ● constant tie-off
Blue = Nios side, green = top-level glue, orange = Caliptra boundary. Source: caliptra2x/rtl_2x/nios_caliptra2x_top.sv, caliptra_passive_top.sv
Nios address map: 0x00000 FW store, 0x7F000 fuse ctrl, 0x80000 Caliptra (AXI 0x00000-0x7FFFF). Nios address = 0x0010_0000 + window offset.
